purpose: Minimum metadata and approvals required to move beyond the verified local candidate. Do not place secret values, private keys, recovery material, bearer tokens, or signing material in this file or in chat.

required: owner name and exact source commit
environment, identity, scope, migration, rollback, and evidence paths
explicit acceptance or rejection by Product 29
approved cluster context and immutable cluster UID
metadata-only Secret Manager references and workload identity
backup target, TLS hostname, and monitoring/alert route ownership
signed change approval and exact mutation acknowledgement
certificate chain, timestamp, transparency record, and revocation route
production release approval bound to product, environment, source, and artifact digest
approved support, privacy, security, and status URLs
immutable hosted artifact URL with digest and byte count
website source commit, deployment identity, and crawler/accessibility acceptance
enable administrator enforcement after active recovery work is merged
approve a commit-signing identity and migration plan before requiring signed commits
